requirements: R1: Identify and resolve the underlying schema state mismatch causing Flyway migration failures
R2: Remove the 'IF NOT EXISTS' statement from the migration introduced in PR #19

slices.title: Resolve DB state mismatch and remove migration mask
slices.jtbd: When implementing the database synchronization fix for this epic, I want to eliminate the migration mask and fix the root cause, so that technical debt is eliminated and infrastructure standards are strictly upheld.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a Flyway migration script that uses 'IF NOT EXISTS' to mask a schema mismatch
When the root cause of the schema mismatch is resolved and the mask is removed
Then the database schema is updated correctly without relying on the mask
And integration tests confirm the migration successfully executes from a clean database state
